title: CreateDatabaseRequest
description: Parameters for creating a new database, including the name and region.

databaseName.description:
The name of the database to be created. Database names must be less than 64
characters, and unique within a workspace. Names may contain letters (lower
or uppercase), numbers, and underscores, and must begin with a letter or
underscore.

region.description:
The region where the database will be hosted. Availability depends on the
workspace flavor and deployment configuration. Use the workspace regions
endpoint to discover available values:
- `AWS_US_WEST_2` - AWS in US West (Oregon)
- `AWS_US_EAST_1` - AWS in US East (Northern Virginia)
- `AWS_EU_CENTRAL_1` - AWS in Europe (Frankfurt)
